intent: A settings switch with weight. The thumb stretches in its direction of travel and lands on a spring, optional glyphs sit in the track, and an async switch holds a spinner on its old position until the change is confirmed. Monochrome by default, one accent prop.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS variables set on the root
stack.animation: motion/react: one spring motion value for position (spring.ui, stiffness 500, damping 40), useVelocity for the stretch, animate for the spring and the count tween, useInView and useReducedMotion for the demo

layout.row: label element wrapping the text column and the track; the whole row is the hit target; labelSide left puts the text first, right puts the track first
layout.gap: 12px sm, 14px md, 16px lg between text and track; 4px tighter inside a container under 20rem (@max-xs)
layout.track: button role=switch, fixed size: sm 32x18 with 14px thumb, md 40x22 with 18px, lg 52x30 with 24px; thumb inset 2px; travel = track - thumb - 4px
layout.root: @container, full width, no padding of its own
layout.demo: 440px card on a theme-following stage that fills the frame (min-h-dvh), header row (Notifications, count of 3 on), three rows with 1px hairline dividers, the third row async; the demo starts with Weekly digest on

typography.label: Geist 500, tracking -0.01em, 13px sm / 14px md / 16px lg
typography.description: Geist 400, 12px sm / 12.5px md / 13.5px lg, line-height 1.45, muted ink
typography.demoHeader: mono 11px uppercase, tracking 0.12em, muted; count uses tabular numerals

color.approach: CSS variables on the root from the theme prop. Dark: ink #f4f4f5, paper #0b0b0c, thumb off #f4f4f5, muted #8a8a93. Light: ink #18181b, paper #ffffff, thumb off #ffffff, muted #71717a.
color.track: Colour sits in the --sw-track variable on the button, never inline, so hover can win. Track: ink at 12% with an inset ring at 16% ink, hover 18%. The fill is a child span, not the track: its width follows the thumb (see motion.fill) and its colour is the accent prop, or the ink, with hover stepping it 12% toward the surface. Hover on the track or the label row lifts the track or fill. Pending and disabled take no hover or press styling.
color.thumb: Off: the thumb-off colour (white in the dark theme). On: the paper colour (near-black in the dark theme) when no accent is set; with an accent, near-black on a light accent (relative luminance over 0.6) and white on a darker one. The thumb swaps between its off and on colour across the middle of its travel (progress 0.44 to 0.56), never at rest, so it is never grey on grey. Shadow: 0 1px 2px at 45% black plus a 0.5px hairline in black at 35% (dark), so a white thumb keeps its edge on a white fill.
color.glyphs: Check in whichever of white or near-black contrasts more on the fill; cross in ink at 45%.
color.accent: One prop, used as given. The first swatch in the playground (#f4f4f5) means the theme's ink: the demo maps it to no accent, so the ink shows (near-black in the light theme).
color.disabled: Row at 40% opacity, cursor-not-allowed, no hover. The playground's Disabled control shows it on the Sync row.
color.error: Refusal line in #f87171 (dark) or #dc2626 (light), both AA on their card.

motion.position: one motion value, animate to 0 or travel with spring.ui (stiffness 500, damping 40). Interruptions carry velocity.
motion.stretch: s = min(|velocity| / (travel * 8), 1) * 0.14; scaleX = 1 + s; scaleY = 1 - s/2; transform origin is the trailing edge (left while moving on, right while moving off). Zero at rest.
motion.colour: The track and fill colours cross-fade over 150ms ease-out on hover only. The thumb's on colour is revealed across the middle of its travel (progress 0.44 to 0.56), in step with the spring, so the swap happens while the stretch peaks.
motion.press: track scales to 0.97 over 150ms (scale property) while the track or its label row is pressed, enabled only
motion.glyphs: check draws on 80ms after the thumb starts moving on; cross draws off with the thumb; opacity 200ms ease-out
motion.pending: Thumb keeps its old position and shows a spinner (animate-spin, stopped under reduced motion); on resolve the thumb springs to the new state and the stretch plays; on reject it stays. Pending drops hover and press styling and shows cursor-progress.
motion.reducedMotion: Position jumps, the thumb swaps colour at once, no stretch, no glyph draw, no spinner rotation, no shake; colour and opacity fades stay at 150ms.
motion.demo: Card rises 12px out of 8px blur over 500ms ease-out; header at 60ms; rows from 160ms, 60ms apart; count tweens 0 to n over 500ms. The cursor hovers each label (not the track), clicks Product updates on, Weekly digest off, then Sync to devices on, which holds its spinner for 800ms. The first attempt to pause Sync is refused in red, so a retry works.
motion.refusal: A rejected change replaces the description with the message in red for 3.5 s or until the next attempt: a cross-fade with a 4px offset and 3px blur over 180ms (opacity only under reduced motion). The thumb shakes in two beats, [0, +4, -2, 0] px toward the requested side, on spring.ui. Reduced motion dims the thumb to half and back over 150ms instead.
motion.fill: A child span grows with the thumb from nothing (off) to the whole track (on): width = thumb position / travel * track width. It is the wake the thumb leaves behind, so the stretch reads as weight rather than a ghost.

responsive.root: @container, the row flexes; the text column shrinks with min-width 0 and wraps
responsive.demo: card max-width 440px, full width below that, stage padding 24px and 40px from sm
responsive.widths: designed at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px with no horizontal overflow

accessibility: role=switch with aria-checked; name via aria-labelledby on the label span; description via aria-describedby
async adds a visually hidden line 'Confirms with the server before it switches.' referenced from aria-describedby
aria-busy while pending; further clicks ignored while pending

A refused change shows its message in a visible red line that replaces the description, and in a visually hidden role=status live region (polite), so it is announced once. The visible line is aria-hidden so it is not read twice.
Space and Enter toggle through the native button
focus-visible: 2px outline offset 2px in the ink colour, instant, keyboard only
decorative glyphs and spinner are aria-hidden
disabled uses the native disabled attribute
reduced motion keeps colour and opacity changes and removes transforms, stretch, glyph drawing and spinner rotation

content.label: Email digests (default), or any short setting name
content.description: One muted line of plain copy under the label
demoRows: Product updates: One note a month, when something you use changes. (starts off)
Weekly digest: Mondays at 8:00, summarising what changed in your notes. (starts on)
Sync to devices: Pushes changes to your other devices. (async; the first attempt to pause it is refused in red, and the retry works)
content.asyncHint: Confirms with the server before it switches. (visually hidden)

avoid: a gradient or glowing track, sparkle or AI iconography, emoji
a bounce beyond the spring's natural overshoot, or a rotate-in
per-row colour, tinted tracks that carry no meaning, rainbow accents
a width change when the spinner appears; the track and thumb keep their size
a separate 'saving' label or pill; the thumb is the status
a checkmark that does not draw on, or a cross that appears without the thumb moving
stretch that persists at rest, or a squash that does not return to 1
a click target smaller than the row for touch users
exposing the async hold as visible text at rest; it belongs in the accessible description
a hover that only changes the track when the pointer is exactly on the thumb; the row is the target
